entries.reason: A seed counts only when the routine spares the scored people at least this much need above the threshold against waiting, per scored person, in need-thousandths times minutes; a comparison scores one group, of any size, so the floor is stated per person. It is the first protocol's floor of 4,600 for the small square's eight people, measured before any model was asked on the eight development seeds through the product's runner with a scripted model (the routine spared from 10,858 to 25,175, median 18,537.5; a quarter of the median, rounded down to the hundred), divided by the eight people it was measured over. A seed under it is excluded by name, never scored, so no seed on which the routine had almost nothing to spare decides a mean.

entries.reason: The most people a comparison runs. A run is replayed from its receipts whenever it is read, and the page reads two runs at once: replaying one run of eight people for the hour through the run route took from 163 to 462 ms on the development machine (scripts/measure_society_comparison.py anchors). Eight is a saved world's own population; a larger society is refused by name rather than read slowly.
